Animal welfare and a quick reminder
The desk is glad to help at dawn
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers must check animal travel details with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure so we can keep each journey smooth and safe. Our staff will review carrier fit, comfort items, and any care notes that affect boarding or transfer.

If your travel is affected by a delayed departure, the usual payout applies. Please keep travel papers close and bring any item needed for your pet's welfare. The welfare coordinator will look over comfort needs and flag any concern before the flight leaves. We welcome direct questions and give clear guidance in a brisk, professional manner.

Please arrive prepared, follow all staff directions, and make sure your pet is secure and calm throughout handling. For prompt help, go to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
